# `SVG_RASTERIZED`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [SVG (`SVG_`)](README.md#domain-svg) |
| Reported by | `mapper` |

## What happened

An SVG with a filter, mask or `foreignObject` was rasterized.

## What to do

Set `capture.svg.rasterizeFilters: false` to try vectors, or simplify the SVG.
